reviewMethod: All 741 English and current Traditional Chinese values were read individually in five ordered blocks. Correct entries were retained. Changes were checked against actual component use, local Chinese Wiki terminology, placeholder identities, and whitespace boundaries. Traditional values were planned editorial.ui overrides at review time; UI compilation is a separate delivery step.

reviewBlocks.checks: Offline preparation, loading phases, skills, effect units, search syntax, and source notices.
Quests, campaign/expansion scope, prerequisites, progress, backup migration, fragments, and source headings.
Characters/accounts, armor crafting, plans, story spoilers, map recovery, rights, and welcome fragments.
Browser/desktop restore scopes, calendar cycles, filters, local records, updates, and source status.
Backup scheduling/retention, import/export, native errors, map markers, signed resources, updates, and query examples.

behaviorReferences.finding: Web full-offline preparation and HTTPS requirement.
Elite yes/no selector rather than item rarity.
Acquisition section heading rather than learning action.
Regeneration/degeneration metrics include both Health and Energy.
Material quantities and fixed fees exclude market prices and upgrades.
Image load failure does not prove a reinstall is needed.
Welcome sentence fragments, selection fallback, and remaining result count.
Desktop versus browser restore guarantees and Web export support.
v1/v2 inputs are migrated to v3.
Routine backups use lastSuccess plus ten minutes; failures retry separately.
All unchanged resource packages are reusable.
Chinese name evidence does not approve the translated body.
